summary: Core agent no longer exits when one storage credential offer is refused (404, replay conflict, invalid handoff or acknowledgement failure); it logs and continues with the remaining offers and the rest of the report response (BUG-0189); the logged error omits the request URL carrying the one-shot offer handle. API impact: none — the credential offer, handoff and acknowledgement contract is unchanged; only the agent's handling of a refused offer changes.

guide.reason: No operator workflow changes: a refused credential request already returned 503 with a retry instruction; the agent simply stays running instead of restarting.

api.reason: API impact: none. GET /api/v1/agent/storage/credentials/{handle}, POST .../ack and POST /api/v1/storage/credentials keep their requests, responses and status codes; the agent now treats a non-200 handoff as a per-request refusal instead of a fatal persistence error.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix within the existing storage credential slice; no milestone or acceptance gate change.

state.reason: No new durable state. Credential receipts remain Core-owned under the agent state directory; the Controller still keeps only its transient 15-second offer.

verification.method: go test -race ./internal/agent -run Credential (new regression failed before the fix with 'credential handoff rejected (HTTP 404)' and passes after); go test -race ./...; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; privacy unittest.
